# 1CityTour

> > Professional guided tours and skip-the-line tickets for Rome's iconic landmarks including the Colosseum, Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, and day trips to Pompeii and Florence.

1CityTour specializes in curated experiences throughout Rome and Italy, offering both group and private tours with expert guides, audioguides, and fast-track access to major archaeological sites, basilicas, and museums. The site also features educational blog content about Roman history, papal traditions, and hidden secrets of Rome's monuments.

## Rome History & Culture Blog

- [CASTEL SANT'ANGELO, THE VATICAN'S SECRET PASSAGES](https://www.1citytour.com/castel-santangelo-the-vaticans-secret-passages): Passetto di Borgo secret Vatican escape route and underground passages
- [ST. PETER'S BASILICA, THE SECRETS OF THE PAPAL GROTTOS](https://www.1citytour.com/st-peters-basilica-the-secrets-of-the-papal-grottos): Vatican Papal Grottos beneath St. Peter's Basilica with papal tombs
- [THE PANTHEON, AN INSCRIPTION WHICH LASTS DURING THE AGES](https://www.1citytour.com/the-pantheon-an-inscription-which-lasts-during-the-ages): Pantheon facade inscription history from Marcus Agrippa to Emperor Augustus
- [WHY ALL THE OBELISKS IN ROME?](https://www.1citytour.com/why-all-the-obelisks-in-rome): Egyptian obelisks in Rome from Augustus Caesar and Roman Empire era
- [THE HOLY DOOR, A DANGEROUS TRADITION](https://www.1citytour.com/the-holy-door-a-dangerous-tradition): History of St. Peter's Basilica Holy Door tradition during Jubilee Year
- [The Holy Stairs](https://www.1citytour.com/the-holy-stairs): Holy Stairs relic from Jesus Christ's trial at St. John Lateran
- [THE CIVIC MUSEUMS, AN UNUSUAL EXPERIENCE IN ROME](https://www.1citytour.com/the-civic-museums-an-unusual-experience-in-rome): Rome Civic Museums guide: archaeology, modern art, Centrale Montemartini
- [THE PANTHEON FOUNTAIN IS BACK!](https://www.1citytour.com/the-pantheon-fountain-is-back): Pantheon Fountain reopening after restoration by Mayor Roberto Gualtieri
